intro.h2: Three ways to change a kitchen, one shop on JVL Industrial Park Drive
paragraphs: Most homeowners call about kitchen remodeling in Marietta, but not every kitchen needs to be torn out. If the layout and cabinet boxes still work, Creative Cabinets and Fine Finishes can refinish them or reface them with new doors and drawer fronts. If the room needs to change, its design team plans a full remodel.

The difference is the shop. Professional sprayers work in a controlled paint booth, so finishes come out clean and smooth. An on-site CNC machine cuts custom cabinets, doors and drawer boxes in-house. On refacing jobs the doors and cabinet frames get the same paint, so they age the same way instead of a veneer peeling with heat and wear.

about.h2: Meet President and Owner Evan Hill
about.text: Evan Hill is President and Owner of Creative Cabinets and Fine Finishes, and he is focused on growing the brand that has served greater Atlanta homeowners for more than 20 years. Evan writes the firm's project stories himself, such as a white and wood kitchen designed from bare studs. Around him is a team clients mention by name: designer Susan, who helped one family reuse existing pieces in a new kitchen, Julie on design and Russell on coordination. The company has won Best of Houzz every year since 2014 and identifies on Google as women-owned.

faq.h2: Refinish, reface or remodel: your questions

items.q: Should I refinish, reface or remodel my kitchen?
items.a: If the layout and cabinet structure still work, refinishing or painting gives a new look at a fraction of the cost of new cabinets. Refacing keeps the boxes but adds new doors, drawer fronts and hardware. If the layout itself is the problem, a full remodel with new cabinets and counters makes sense.

items.q: How is this different from hiring a painter?
items.a: CCFF has professional sprayers on staff and sprays in a controlled paint booth, which gives a clean, smooth finish. Over the years the team has tested many products and uses only the paints and stains it trusts for cabinets. It can also swap in new hardware or hinges as part of the job.

items.q: Will refaced doors match my cabinet frames?
items.a: Yes. Many refacing companies add veneers that can peel over time from heat and wear, leaving doors that no longer match. CCFF finishes both the doors and the cabinets with the same paint so they age together, and builds doors and drawer boxes in-house on its CNC machine.

items.q: Can you work with my own contractor?
items.a: Yes. If you already have a third-party contractor or handyman involved, CCFF will gladly work alongside that team. On full projects, a dedicated project manager communicates with you daily and keeps the workspace clean and organized so your home stays livable.

items.q: Do you come to my part of Atlanta?
items.a: Yes, most likely. The team works throughout metro Atlanta from its Marietta shop, including Kennesaw, Roswell, Alpharetta, Woodstock, Canton, Smyrna, Sandy Springs, Buckhead, Dunwoody and Decatur. Call (770) 693-1896 or book online to set up your first appointment and talk through what your kitchen or bath needs.
